meaning:
βασίλειον, -ου, τό
(βασίλειος, which see), [in LXX for הֵיכָל ( Nam.2:6, Dan.6:18*), מַמְלָכָה ( 3Ki.3:1 14:8, 4Ki.15:19*), etc. ;]
1. a capital city.
2. Freq. in pl., τὰ β., a palace: Luk.7:25.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
